column1: # The game calls nvnDeviceSetDepthMode(near=0) (run log: "depth mode near=0"), so its vertex shaders use the main0_z entries; the pipeline bases made before it runs are made for that mode (as Silver Pines)
# address regions: 2026-11-07, in its first 15 s in nnMain the game's regions reach alias +1.26 GB, within the 4.38 GB alias region; about 2.5 GB resident in the first forest (Mac)
# Packed-half results clamped to the half range on the Mac (dmsh_build.py half_clamp): the toon eye pass 937e832a1b3b3068 overflowed to inf in Metal and drew the eyes white
# Defaults for this game only (front_android.c; env.txt overrides each). Outdoors in Bloomfield (11-11, hm_next3, KEEP=0): 3.5-4.3 fps, recording 216-256 ms a frame, ~400 MB a frame of
# index-pool copies for GPU-indirect indexed draws, ~6100 GPU-written lookups walking ~930k entries. RING_REUSE keeps the extra rings (the forest's 500 MB a frame of fresh rings went to
# ~16 MB); IDXPOOL_KEEP keeps the index pools across frames (hm-fix-b: host write-backs seen); GW_PAD pads small GPU-written copies; GW_LCACHE caches the GPU-written lookups per submission.
# hm-fix-2 (11-13 profile of hm-fix-all outdoors, 14 fps): 271 composes a frame each ended the render pass (407 passes a frame) and every pass begin cost the driver a calloc from scudo's
# secondary allocator (mmap + memset, 25% of all CPU; the frees at the pool reset on dm-complete, munmap). GW_SHADOW gives the cull dispatches' instance lists, read 16 bytes in, an aligned
# copy right after the dispatch; MALLOC_CACHE keeps 128 freed driver blocks of at most 2 MB instead of 32 (about one
# frame's passes once GW_SHADOW takes the breaks; worst case 256 MB idle, purged with malloc under real memory pressure); WB_PREP unprotects the pages a write-back writes instead of a fault per page.
# hm-fix-3 (11-13 tablet H0 run): standing still outdoors, the cull draws' GPU-written instances grew +155 a frame (24k -> 428k a frame) and the GPU time with them
# (+25 ms per 600 frames): each frame's dispatch binds last frame's still-running range (chained, 361 a frame) and the game's CPU-side counter reset never reached it
# (whole write-backs overwrote 150-230 KB of CPU writes a frame). GW_CHAIN_SNAP (C1) snapshots chained ranges and patches the CPU's rewrites in. The Mac (Metal) is flat
# at ~10.5 ms GPU there. IDXPOOL_ROTATE: during the load, index data streamed into kept pools ('written since the copy' 130-446 draws a second, 8 MB copies each).
# hm-fix-2d: GW_PAD_SMALL retries a refused padded window at 256 / 64 bytes (the indirect argument records next to the cull's instance lists: ~170 composes a frame outdoors).
